name: Concord Summer 2023
information: Please always include your **name** and competition name in any email that you send to us. All competitors must read the "Competitor Information" tab prior to registering. Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email. Only **two** guests per competitor will be allowed. **No outside food or drink is allowed in the venue** This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://www.cubingusa.org/).
